data.value: How this attribute corresponds to its counterparts in the SCIM 2.0 and LDAP/Active Directory standards, to guide you when designing Attribute Flows. For reference only: what synchronizes is always determined by your Attribute Flows, never by these mappings.

data.name: ClaimsPageInfo
data.value: Claims are what your identity provider asserted about you when you signed in. JIM uses them to establish who you are, show your name and decide what you may do. This page lists every claim on your session, which helps when diagnosing sign-in, authorization or identity mapping problems.

data.name: DeleteAttributeReadersBody
data.value: Change or remove each one first, then delete. JIM does not remove them for you: a Scoping Criterion removed from a Synchronization Rule changes which objects the rule manages.
